name: fix_ts_promise_all
description: Fixes an async map that returns pending promises instead of resolved values
prompts: orders.ts doesn't compile under `tsc --strict`: loadOrders is declared to resolve to Order[], but ids.map(async ...) produces Promise<Order>[] - an array of pending promises, which also breaks grandTotal at runtime (it reduces over promises, yielding NaN). Fix orders.ts so it compiles under --strict and loadOrders actually resolves to the fetched orders (Promise.all is the standard tool). Don't change the function signatures.

test_setup_files.run_checks.sh:
set -e
tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --noEmit orders.ts 
tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --outDir build orders.ts
node behavior_test.js
